title: 1.0 is the starting point: release gate without 0.x scenarios
question: D16 requires the P4 design to re-evaluate every 0.7.0 scenario left in the release gate (condition 5 populated fixtures, condition 8 readable 0.7.0 audit rows, condition 10 upgrade map), the 'prior profiles' of I22 and the P4 deliverable 'one complete 0.7.0 upgrade guide'. What does the 1.0 gate contain?

options.text: Remove every 0.x premise: condition 5 = DDL fixtures and fresh-install scenarios on four drivers (D19); condition 8 without 0.7.0 audit rows; condition 10 = the candidate is the compatibility baseline and the AI-agent instruction covers the transition; I22 = the candidate's load/query profile is recorded as the 1.0 reference (no comparison with any earlier version, the 2026-10-09 results are removed); stable-tag resolution ignores v0.3.0/v0.7.0; P4 deliverables name 1.0.0 release notes instead of a 0.7.0 upgrade guide.
Keep the gate wording with the 0.7.0 scenarios and compare load with v0.7.0.

context: P4 design session 2026-10-14. Asked with the proposal 'condition 5 fresh installs, condition 8 without 0.7.0 rows, condition 10 AI instruction + candidate baseline, I22 paired bench v0.7.0 vs candidate'; owner answer M17: «Забудь про 0.7 вообще, пакет нигде еще не используется, отправной точкой будет 1.0» — so also the paired v0.7.0 bench is dropped.
decision: A — Remove every 0.x premise: condition 5 = DDL fixtures and fresh-install scenarios on four drivers (D19); condition 8 without 0.7.0 audit rows; condition 10 = the candidate is the compatibility baseline and the AI-agent instruction covers the transition; I22 = the candidate's load/query profile is recorded as the 1.0 reference (no comparison with any earlier version, the 2026-10-09 results are removed); stable-tag resolution ignores v0.3.0/v0.7.0; P4 deliverables name 1.0.0 release notes instead of a 0.7.0 upgrade guide.
rationale: Owner M17: 1.0 is the starting point; the package is not used anywhere, so no 0.x scenario, history or performance comparison belongs in the gate.
consequences: knowledge/p4-execution#gate replaces conditions 5, 8, 10 and the I22 wording of knowledge/architecture#release-gate; the other conditions are unchanged.
B18 ('assume 0.7.0 is installed') no longer binds P4 (B23).
bench/results/2026-10-09-* are deleted; the 1.0 candidate results become the reference for later compare.php runs.
The comparator's auto baseline accepts only tags vX.Y.Z with X >= 1; the existing v0.3.0 and v0.7.0 tags stay untouched (owner territory).
P4 contract.produces and deliverables are reworded accordingly.

evidence.note: «Забудь про 0.7 вообще, пакет нигде еще не используется, отправной точкой будет 1.0»
